original_value: ThinkPad 256GB SAMSUNG PCIe NVME TLC OPAL M.2 SSD supporting PCIe 3.0 interface standard up to 4 lanes shows much faster performance than previous SATA SSDs.

result.paraphrase: ThinkPad 256GB SAMSUNG PCIe NVMe TLC OPAL M.2 SSD, compatible with the PCIe 3.0 interface standard and using up to 4 lanes, delivers much faster performance than earlier SATA SSDs.
